blurb: Bear Creek Golf Club features a Rees Jones Signature golf course with Super Dwarf TifEagle Bermuda greens designed for Low-country weather. The course is conducive to walking or using a golf cart and offers a practice facility with a multi-tiered practice tee and short game area. Instruction is available through individual lessons and weekly clinics.
extraNote: At least 24 hours notice required to cancel or change tee times · No-show fee charged if cancellation not made within 24 hours · Course closed on Christmas Day and some maintenance days
